reviews.review_description:
Really fun and exciting VR game! The gameplay is engaging, and the experience feels immersive. I enjoyed the challenge and the thrill of trying to survive each round. Great work by the developers!
Suggestion: It would be great to see more levels, additional challenges, and new environments to make the game even more exciting and replayable. Adding multiplayer features would also make it more fun to play with friends.
Overall, an enjoyable experience. Keep up the great work! 🎮

developer_response.body: Thank you for your great feedback and suggestions! We're glad you're enjoying the game. More exciting features and improvements are planned for future updates! 🎮

reviews.review_description: such a great experience loved the concept in VR can't wait for multiplayer mode in it to enjoy it with friends

developer_response.body: Thank you for your feedback! We're glad you enjoyed the VR experience. Multiplayer Mode is coming soon, so you'll be able to enjoy it with your friends. Stay tuned!
